parsed.name: catalyst_calendar_6m
parsed.strategy: I only hold names with a dated catalyst inside the six-month horizon, spread across dates so no single day decides the book: a 10-name FDA PDUFA cluster (Oct 10 through Dec 30), a semicap earnings cluster (ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, TER Oct 27), and single-date events for ARGX, CCJ, SAAB-B.ST and EVO.ST. The bet is that dated binary and print events, not theme momentum, drive relative return versus SPY. I would be wrong if a broad risk-off tape swamps event-specific outcomes, if the FDA cluster draws multiple CRLs in the same month, or if the semicap prints show AI-capex digestion rather than acceleration.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return versus SPY, net of costs, using only dated-catalyst names.
